'''K2-3Z3''' was a [[3Z3 medical droid]] in the service of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. In [[137 ABY]], after the [[Battle of Borosk (137 ABY)|Battle of Borosk]], K2-3Z3 saw to the medical treatment of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Ran Harkas]] of [[Joker Squad]].
